answer.headline: Single-runway towered airports ranked by CY 2025 tower operations

claims.text: SAN's observed open-runway count is {F398}. The ranked airports are the towered US airports with that same open-runway count.
In CY 2025, observed tower operations are {F593} at SAN and {F539} at BKG, the high and low ends of the within-set rank. The matching scores are {F625} at SAN and {F719} at BKG.
Over {F720.period}, the filtered set's calculated general-aviation share of tower operations is {F720}, calculated airline operations are {F721}, and observed tower operations are {F722}.

General-aviation share and airline operations answer different questions. The share describes the ATADS user mix. Airline operations count T-100 departures plus arrivals. Reading the airline total as the non-GA slice of tower operations is not supported.

assumptions: The question does not name a period. CY 2025 is used because it is a full calendar year inside both ATADS coverage and T-100 coverage, so the rank and the aggregates share one window.
The question does not name a place. The universe is US airports that appear in ATADS, because tower operations and general-aviation share are observed only at towered airports.
Rank scores use minmax scaling within the filtered set. Higher tower operations score higher. Adding or removing airports would change the scores.
The cohort general-aviation share is the ratio of sums at the group grain, so airports with more tower operations weigh more than they would in an equal-weighted average of airport shares.
limitations: PGL matches the open-runway filter but has no tower-operations, general-aviation-share, or airline-operations row for this window, so it is unscored and does not contribute to the cohort totals.
ATADS counts operations during tower hours for every user class. Airline operations are T-100 departures plus arrivals, all configurations. They are not a user-class share of the tower total.
Open-runway counts come from a static inventory. A time comparison is not defined for that metric.
This is a metric rank, not the investment screen, so screen flags and scenario weights are not attached. No tower-operation totals are tied.
Unmet demand, terminal capacity, fares, and profitability are not measured. The rank is not a valuation.
Airports in the filter with no T-100 rows add nothing to the airline-operations total.
